Returns verified public cottages. Without `limit` and `page`, all matching rows are returned; with either query param, results are paginated (default page size 20, max `limit` 100). Supports search, filtering, and sorting.

post.description: Partner-only. Creates a new cottage listing. The property is created with verification_status=waiting.

schema.description: Partner cottage create. Send flat `price_*` amounts plus either (A) omit all month fields — server uses current and next calendar month, or (B) set `month_from`, `month_to`, `next_month_from`, `next_month_to` (full month ranges, YYYY-MM-DD). Do not use a nested `price` array (legacy; still accepted by the API if month fields are not used).

price_per_person.description: Per-person price (both months unless you vary via legacy `price` list only).

month_from.description: First pricing month: interval start (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with month_to, next_month_from, next_month_to.

month_to.description: First pricing month: interval end (YYYY-MM-DD). Should be the last day of that month.

img.description: Image paths or URLs; a single string is also accepted by the API.

get.description: Same as `PropertyRetrieveUpdateDestroyView` but Swagger documents cottage PATCH body (flat, like create).

price.description: Apartment price in UZS (converted from USD if needed). Null for cottages.

price_per_person.description: Cottage price per person in UZS. Null for apartments.

price_on_working_days.description: Cottage working-day price in UZS. Null for apartments.

price_on_weekends.description: Cottage weekend price in UZS. Null for apartments.

monthly_prices.description: Cottage monthly price breakdown. Empty/null for apartments.

items.description: One calendar month of prices. `month_from` is the first day of the month; `month_to` is the last day (full month). Price amounts may be omitted if the same top-level `price_per_person`, `price_on_working_days`, `price_on_weekends` apply.

description_uz.description: Uzbek description for apartments (falls back to en/ru if empty).

patch.description: Partner-only partial update for a cottage. Request body matches POST /api/property/cottages/ (flat `price_*`, month range fields, location, descriptions, services, rooms); all fields optional.

schema.description: Partner cottage partial update (PATCH). Same flat fields as POST /api/property/cottages/; all optional — send only what changes. Pricing: use `price_*` with optional `month_from` / `month_to` / `next_month_from` / `next_month_to` (all four together), or legacy `price` list (not documented here). Changing non-price fields may reset verification.

price_per_person.description: Per-person price (both months unless you vary via legacy `price` list only).

month_from.description: First pricing month: interval start (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with month_to, next_month_from, next_month_to.

month_to.description: First pricing month: interval end (YYYY-MM-DD). Should be the last day of that month.

img.description: Image paths or URLs; a single string is also accepted by the API.
